verdict.rationale: SES's own documentation says access to email sending can be controlled with AWS IAM, which is the mechanism for issuing scoped credentials to an agent. The pack gives only this one-line mention, with no detail on how granular the scoping is or how agent-specific credentials would be issued. Missing for 10: documented examples of SES-specific least-privilege policies (e.g., restricting sending to certain identities or actions), scoped SMTP credential issuance, an agent-oriented credential workflow, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent

citations.quote: Control user access to your email sending by using AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM).
